heading: At the hotel
observation: A French-language supper at the Bellevue-Stratford pairs terrapin with a list that includes peaches Melba. The transcription records no individual prices for this menu.

image.alt: The original Bellevue-Stratford supper menu, January 2, 1914
image.rights: NYPL identifies this item as public domain under United States law; it does not determine rights elsewhere.

heading: At the counter
observation: At Horn & Hardart, a cup of coffee with cream appears alongside a frizzled-beef omelet. Philadelphia is printed on the menu; the particular outlet remains unknown.

heading: On Chestnut Street
observation: Kugler’s in the Widener Building lists its own snapper soup and six prime oysters. This is the Chestnut Street restaurant; the Marine Grill has a separate menu and address.
